title: Patch: Heroic Power's powers, the Anomaly titles and the other words the client translates from a table read in Chinese for a Chinese reader, held by a test
notes: Client-only translation coverage: about 97 new zh-CN dictionary entries for words that reach t() through a table or ?? (Heroic Power's powers on both faces, the Anomaly titles, the board-names setting words, the blocked-draw texts, Newest first, the Duo mark), the literals() scan widened to ?? and ||, a table-walk test holding every table-fed word to a dictionary entry, and one-word exports (BOARD_NAMES_OPTIONS, DEFAULT_ORDER) so the walk can reach them. No engine, card, server or rules change.

player.title: More Chinese across the client
fixes: Players reading in Simplified Chinese now see Heroic Power's powers, the Anomaly titles and the board-names setting in Chinese.
